# Test Scenario: Stack Animation Operations (Android)

| ------------ | ----------------------------------------- |
| Key          | `test-stack-animation-operations-android` |
| Platforms    | Android                                   |
| E2E coverage | Incomplete                                |
| Smoke test   | No                                        |

| Device        | Test on      | Setup                                                                                          |
| ------------- | ------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Android phone | API Level 37 | System animations on (Settings → Accessibility → Color and motion → Remove animations is off). |

**E2E coverage details:** No step is automated. For manual testing perform all steps. Which screen moves, in which direction, and whether an intermediate screen flashes are not assertable with Detox; only the resulting stack would be.

<!-- scenario-metadata:end -->

## Description

Verify which screen's `animation` plays for each shape of a
stack operation on Android: a single push and pop, a multi-push, a multi-pop, a
replace and a multi-replace, and what a new operation does to a transition that
is still running. Every route carries a different preset, so exactly one
direction is correct for each operation. Pass: only the screen that ends on top
(push) or that was on top (pop, replace) moves, and no other screen in the
batch is ever visible. Every replace here uses the default `replaceAnimation:
'pop'`; the `push` value is covered by `test-stack-animation-replace`.

## Note

- Wait for every transition to finish before the next tap, except where a step
  says to tap during one.
- Static: the screen does not move and stays fully visible for the whole
  transition.

## Steps

### Baseline

1. Launch the app and navigate to the **Stack Animation Operations (Android)**
   screen.

   - [ ] The screen is yellow with the title "Home · default", and "Pop",
         "Pop 2", "Pop 3", "Replace with Right", "Replace with Bottom" and
         "Replace 2 with Left + Top" are disabled.

---

### Single push and pop

1. Tap "Push Right".

   - [ ] "Right" (blue) slides in from the right and "Home" slides out to the
         left.

2. On "Right", tap "Pop".

   - [ ] "Right" slides out to the right and "Home" slides in from the left.

---

### Multi-push

1. Tap "Push Left + Top".

   - [ ] "Top" (purple) drops in from the top edge above a static "Home"; no
         red screen and no leftward slide appears at any point.
   - [ ] "Pop 2" is enabled.

2. On "Top", tap "Pop".

   - [ ] "Top" rises out through the top edge above a static "Left" (red).

3. On "Left", tap "Pop".

   - [ ] "Left" slides out to the left and "Home" slides in from the right.

4. Tap "Push Right + Bottom + Left".

   - [ ] "Left" slides in from the left and "Home" slides out to the right; no
         blue and no green screen appears at any point.
   - [ ] "Pop 3" is enabled.

---

### Multi-pop

1. On "Left", tap "Pop 2".

   - [ ] "Left" slides out to the left and "Right" (blue) slides in from the
         right; "Bottom" (green) never appears.

2. On "Right", tap "Push Top".

   - [ ] "Top" drops in from the top edge above a static "Right".

3. On "Top", tap "Pop 2".

   - [ ] "Top" rises out through the top edge above a static "Home"; "Right"
         never appears.
   - [ ] "Pop" is disabled on "Home".

---

### Replace

1. Tap "Push Right", then tap "Replace with Bottom" on it.

   - [ ] "Right" slides out to the right and "Bottom" (green) slides in from
         the left; "Bottom" does not rise from the bottom edge and "Home"
         does not appear.
   - [ ] "Pop" is enabled and "Pop 2" is disabled.

2. On "Bottom", tap "Pop".

   - [ ] "Bottom" sinks to the bottom edge above a static "Home".

3. Tap "Push Left", then tap "Replace with Right" on it.

   - [ ] "Left" slides out to the left and "Right" slides in from the right.

---

### Multi-replace

1. On "Right", tap "Push Bottom", then tap "Replace 2 with Left + Top" on
   "Bottom".

   - [ ] "Bottom" sinks to the bottom edge above "Top" (purple), which is
         already in place; no blue screen and no leftward slide appears, and
         "Top" does not drop in from the top edge.
   - [ ] "Pop 2" is enabled.

2. On "Top", tap "Pop".

   - [ ] "Top" rises out through the top edge above a static "Left".

3. On "Left", tap "Pop".

   - [ ] "Left" slides out to the left and "Home" slides in from the right.

---

### Interrupted operations

1. Tap "Push Right 2000 ms", then tap "Push Bottom 2000 ms" on "Right 2000 ms"
   while it is still sliding in.

   - [ ] "Right 2000 ms" jumps to its final position.
   - [ ] "Bottom 2000 ms" then rises from the bottom edge above a static
         "Right 2000 ms".

2. On "Bottom 2000 ms", tap "Pop", then tap "Pop" on "Right 2000 ms" while
   "Bottom 2000 ms" is still sinking.

   - [ ] "Bottom 2000 ms" disappears at once.
   - [ ] "Right 2000 ms" then slides out to the right and "Home" slides in
         from the left.

3. Tap "Push Right + Bottom + Left 2000 ms", then tap "Pop 3" on
   "Left 2000 ms" while it is still sliding in.

   - [ ] "Left 2000 ms" jumps to its final position.
   - [ ] "Left 2000 ms" then slides out to the left and "Home" slides in from
         the right; no blue and no green screen appears.
   - [ ] "Pop" is disabled on "Home".

4. Tap "Push Right 2000 ms", then tap "Replace with Bottom" on "Right 2000 ms"
   while it is still sliding in.

   - [ ] "Right 2000 ms" jumps to its final position.
   - [ ] "Right 2000 ms" then slides out to the right and "Bottom" slides in
         from the left beside it; "Home" is not visible.

5. On "Bottom", tap "Pop", then tap "Push Right 2000 ms", then tap the header
   back button on "Right 2000 ms" while it is still sliding in.

   - [ ] "Right 2000 ms" jumps to its final position.
   - [ ] "Right 2000 ms" then slides out to the right and "Home" slides in
         from the left.
   - [ ] "Pop" is disabled on "Home".
